name: Mirror Image
description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Each time a creature targets you with an attack, a duplicate may be struck instead, and the duplicate is destroyed.
effect: Three illusory doubles each take one attack that would have hit you (10 rounds).
notes: In combat: three illusory doubles. Each time an attack would hit you, a double takes it instead and vanishes. No concentration, 10 rounds.
